title: yaml-dsl.yml
description: The workspace's YAML DSLs: which files each one owns and the syntax of its names, references, placeholders and calls.

file_includes.description: Globs of the files the DSL owns.

file_excludes.description: Globs of files the DSL does not own, even when file_includes matches them.

schema_search_paths.description: Schemas tried in order when a file names none, or the one it names is not on disk. Each path is relative to the file; a URL is fetched.

key_sort_orders.description: Where an edit places a new key in each map. The first entry whose path covers the map applies.

references.description: How names are referenced. Rules reading the same text are tried in order.

layers.description: The common layer and its overlays. Left out for a DSL without layers.

common_layer_discovery.description: Where the common layer sits: the overlay folder's parent, or the nearest ancestor above an overlay folder.

duplicate_check.description: The check of an overlay for what the common layer already holds.

depth.description: How many levels below the document root the check runs, under a top-level key key_depths does not list.

key_depths.description: The depth under a given top-level key, {} when every key takes depth.

skip_keys.description: Keys the check passes over, at any depth.

placeholder.description: The placeholder syntax. Left out for a DSL without placeholders.

pattern.description: Regular expression of a placeholder, with a (?<body>...) group.

unscanned_paths.description: Paths whose text is another language's and is not read for placeholders.

function.description: Function calls. Left out for a DSL without calls.

definitions.description: Sources of the function table, merged in order.

call_result_reference_positions.description: Positions from which a name a call declares may be referenced.

calls_not_allowed_at.description: Paths where a call is a problem.

locals.description: Named values. Left out for a DSL without locals.

scope_name.description: The scope, declared under scopes, whose declarations are the locals.

marker_function.description: A call written in a key: <name> <call_marker><function>. Left out when the DSL's calls take another shape.

call_marker.description: Text that opens a call in a key.

splat_operator.description: Suffix after the function that spreads a list value into the arguments.

calls_without_name_allowed.description: Whether a key that is the marker alone is a call, the only key of its map.

scopes.description: The DSL's scopes. A name in capitals is a logical scope; any other name is the DSL's own word.

regions.description: Paths whose subtree in any file of the fold sees the scope's names; $ is the whole fold.

later_items_of_declaring_list.description: Whether a name is also visible in the later items of the list that declares it.

named_by_parent_key.description: Whether the mapping key enclosing a declaration is the scope its name is in. Logical scopes only.

builtin_names.description: Names the scope holds without a declaration. Logical scopes only.

skip_keys.description: Keys a .*, [*] or ..* step does not descend into.

exclude_candidates.description: Keys at the last step that declare nothing.

name_source.description: Where the name is read: the key, the scalar value, or a meta argument of the key.

key_token.description: The words of the key that are the name; null when the name is not read from the key.

name_spelling.description: How the name is spelled for references.

meta_argument_name.description: The meta argument holding the name; null when the name is not read from a meta argument.

declares_every_name.description: Whether the key declares every name of the scope, for names defined in a document the editor does not read.

pattern.description: Regular expression of a reference, with named groups.

positions.description: Positions the reference may stand in.

text_after_name_allowed.description: Whether text such as a field path may follow the name.

scope_name.description: The scope the reference resolves in, declared under scopes.

scope_group.description: The pattern group holding the scope of a named_by_parent_key scope; null for any other scope.

name_group.description: The pattern group holding the name.

skip_keys.description: Keys a .*, [*] or ..* step does not select or descend into.

order.description: Where a new key goes among the map's keys.

first_keys.description: Under significance, keys at the top of the map, in this order. [] under alphabetical.

last_keys.description: Under significance, keys at the bottom of the map, in this order. [] under alphabetical.

skip_keys.description: Keys a .*, [*] or ..* step does not select or descend into.

includes_subtree.description: Deprecated: list the path ending in ..* as its own entry instead.
includes_subtree.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: list the path ending in ..* as its own entry instead.

path.description: A JSONPath (RFC 9535) from $, with .name, .* and [*] steps and an optional final ..*.
